integrity: The proof uses Smith diagonalization over arbitrary finite commutative chain rings and a bipartite matching argument; finite verification on truncated polynomial rings is corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Determines sharp maximal image-module generator count and all attainable smaller counts for a fixed first factor; does not classify all zero-insertive matrices or all Smith shapes. Independent audit has not been performed; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp image-generator capacity of zero-insertive matrices over finite chain rings
